layman_headline: Weak swing candidates force patience — waiting for a better setup.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a 'Fear' state at 30/100, which is slowly improving from last week's average of 27. Bitcoin is bouncing around $65K and dominance is high at 56.8%, meaning altcoins are struggling. The swing trade candidates presented this cycle are mostly stablecoins and gold-backed tokens — none offer the 5-20% swing upside we look for with acceptable risk. The most interesting movers in the broader top 20 are ADA (+18.5% in 7 days) and ZEC (+10.7%), but neither appeared in the swing candidates list with full technical data.
layman_action: Stay in cash this cycle. The available setups don't meet our quality bar — stablecoins won't swing and gold tokens already ran 7%. Wait for a proper altcoin pullback with clear RSI oversold conditions.
expert_reasoning: The swing candidate pool is exceptionally poor this cycle: FDUSD, USDG, and EURC are stablecoins with no swing potential. XAUT and PAXG are gold-pegged tokens already up 7%+ on the week with XAUT's RSI at 41 (not truly oversold) — chasing here offers poor risk/reward. UB is down 10.8% weekly but RSI is 56 (neutral), meaning the pullback hasn't created oversold conditions yet. MON is 57% off ATH with no technical data. Meanwhile, the broader market shows ADA surging 18.5% weekly and ZEC up 10.7%, but these aren't in our candidate pool with sufficient data. BTC dominance at 56.8% actively suppresses alt performance. Discipline dictates waiting.
